examples.description: Dismiss a reminder after firing it locally

failure_modes.recovery: Call sticky_note_due (or sticky_note_list) to find a valid id.
failure_modes.when: the id does not exist in your tenant

preconditions: Pass the note id; this clears its triggers_at so it is no longer due.

description: Clear a sticky note's reminder (triggers_at back to NULL) so it drops out of the sticky_note_due poll — call this after the host fires the local notification for it. Runs through the same tenant-scoped write path as every entity update, but via a clear-properties op: ordinary updates ignore null values, so this is the only way to null the column. Idempotent — dismissing an already-cleared note just re-nulls a NULL and succeeds. NEXT: sticky_note_due to see what's still outstanding.

id.description: The sticky note id to dismiss (sticky_note_due or sticky_note_list shows them).

name: sticky_note_dismiss
